researchBasis.evidenceCeiling: Peer reports and commits identify test leads only. Local generated controls are not peer fixtures, independent producer evidence, or native acceptance.

controls: Add a locally generated CR-bearing MTEXT issue-shaped payload and require atomic refusal across AC1018/AC1021/AC1032, ASCII/Binary, and Compatible/RequireLossless policies.
Exercise C0 and MIF-transformed text through explicit-length ASCII/Binary writers; assert exact expected wire bytes, semantic readback, following-record sentinel, and no trailing record.
Run the existing generated AC1018-TV and AC1021-TU source-DWG integration through strict AC1027 ASCII export, checking raw target bytes, semantic values, graph ownership, and following sentinels.

tvTuEntityIntegration.result: PASS (AC1018-TV and AC1021-TU to AC1027 ASCII)

limitations: The #1408 reproducer is locally generated and does not reproduce the unavailable peer drawing.
The #1412 issue concerns a C-specific helper; local explicit-length C++ tests are controls, not proof against all allocation or framing defects.
The #1414 source-TV/source-TU integration is a local roundtrip and does not resolve intended field-specific escape policy.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty and repository Git metadata is read-only; this slice is uncommitted.
nextReadinessSlice: Continue the existing local source-backed implementation queue. Do not wait for peer drawings or unresolved #1414 policy; do not promote support from self-roundtrip evidence.
